about.title: About Me
about.name: Mina Hanna
about.summary: Dedicated AI Implementation Specialist and current Master's student at LETI University, specializing in deploying AI-driven services and prompt engineering workflows. Leveraging 3.5 years of solid technical experience in full stack development to bridge the gap between complex AI models and practical business applications.

about.experienceCompany: Indra Sistemas (Suez Canal Tunnels Project 'Tahia Misr')
about.experience1: Developed and maintained backend infrastructure for mission-critical monitoring systems, providing a foundation for high-reliability data pipelines.
about.experience2: Collaborated on cross-functional teams to integrate modern web dashboards with legacy control systems, focusing on data accessibility and real-time processing.
about.experience3: Applied structured development methodologies (SDLC) to ensure scalable, secure, and maintainable software delivery in a high-stakes environment.
about.experience4: Utilized Python and JavaScript to optimize system workflows, laying the groundwork for implementing automated AI-driven diagnostic tools.
